detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

How to annoy two purist camps at once:

1. Run FreeBSD 15.1-RELEASE on a ThinkPad T480.
2. Let an agentic AI (Crush + GLM 5.3 Flash) write the Ansible roles for rc.conf, pf.conf, and loader.conf.   

I know AI isn't the most popular topic around here, but watching a TUI agent haggle with a missing Jinja2 module in real time is great entertainment for a single cent. And the result was actually good after reviewing and tweaking it just a little. 

#FreeBSD #RunBSD #ThinkPad #T480 #Ansible #DevOps #bsdcafe #ai #genai
